LESSON: PATTERNS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Pre-Number Activities
Topic 1.4: Patterns
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Patterns, part of Pre-Number Activities in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: How can you make patterns with play objects?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Observe and talk about different play objects in the school neighbourhood. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative modes of communication to give their views.

2. Team up with others to make pattern using play objects as they observe safety. Create a conducive environment and adequate space for all learners especially those using mobility devices and ensure safety standards are upheld for all learners.

3. Fill in the missing play objects in a pattern. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or appropriate assistive

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Observe and talk about different play objects in the school neighbourhood. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative modes of communication to give their views.
2. Team up with others to make pattern using play objects as they observe safety. Create a conducive environment and adequate space for all learners especially those using mobility devices and ensure safety standards are upheld for all learners.
3. Fill in the missing play objects in a pattern. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or appropriate assistive

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Patterns together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Creativity and imagination: learners make patterns using different play objects creatively.

Values:
Respect: learners exercise patience and take turns as they team up to make patterns.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Safety: learners observe safety as they arrange play objects to make patterns.

Link to Other Activity Areas:

The learner is able to relate making patterns using different play objects to pattern making in Creative Activities.
